scope: Read-only cross-track AIW evidence recovered only through python tools/f1c_mod.py.

verified_parser_facts.number_waypoints: Allocates 316 * declared count bytes plus 4 and constructs that many records. The count guard is reached only when wp_ptrs is parsed, after fields for the current cursor have already been written; it is not a safe bound against excess textual waypoint records.

field_layout.wp_event_or_wp_wpse: wp_event parses a three-float tuple: first value remains at +0x084 (v4[33]); latter values are float-to-int converted and stored at +0x134/+0x138 (v4[77]/v4[78]). wp_wpse parses an integer pair to the same latter destinations. Because parsing is line-by-line, the last applicable key encountered in file order wins.
field_layout.wp_score: integer/float pair at +0x44/+0x48 in the live record (sector, lap distance), independently FACT-backed.

verified_parser_facts.integer_syntax: sub_565760 accepts exact parenthesized one/two/three/four-integer tuples according to requested arity; one integer also accepts bare decimal syntax.

cross_track_semantics.branch_ids: RAW corpus fact: branch ID is the integer at +0x12c and AI route code distinguishes value 1 from other values. Separately, this session's 2002 Monza asset proves branch 0 is its main route, branch 1 its pit route, IDs 2..25 its grid selectors, and IDs 106..117 its pit-team selectors. Those meanings and numeric bands are asset-local evidence, not a global allocation contract.
cross_track_semantics.wp_bitfields: The corpus proves only an integer field with shipped values 0 or 1. No front-door evidence establishes individual bit meanings. The active Monza asset correlates value 1 with its placement-selector pseudo-nodes, but that asset-local pattern does not establish a universal flag taxonomy.
cross_track_semantics.events: wp_event is present in 179/198 indexed AIWs; wp_wpse in 11/198. Both populate the same latter two runtime destinations; the last applicable line encountered wins. Treat wp_wpse as alternate syntax, not a generically later override or an independently additive event channel. RAW route code in AIRacingLine tests record +0x134 == 1 and then uses record +0x138 as its pass-score term; otherwise it derives that term. This proves the latter pair affects AI route scoring, but does not establish a human-readable event taxonomy for every value.
cross_track_semantics.all_tracks: An inherited CONFIRMED finding reports a separate validation over 209 real AIWs with pit-lane entrance preceding the pit-entry line in 209 OK / 0 FAIL / 0 EDGE. The current front door does not expose that run's per-file manifest or validator output, so this was not independently reproduced today. It generalizes only the reported lane-start ordering, not Monza's waypoint numbers or branch-ID bands.

capacity_and_outliers.declared_vs_observed: number_waypoints has 199 indexed files but branch/bitfields keys 198; its global range includes zero. This is a corpus-index outlier requiring per-file identity support before calling any asset malformed.
capacity_and_outliers.record_count_guard: The parser reaches its count check only at wp_ptrs, after waypoint fields have already written through the current cursor and after the cursor may advance one record past the allocation. Extra textual waypoint-field lines can therefore write out of bounds before the next wp_ptrs guard returns. No shipped malformed identity was assessed.
capacity_and_outliers.grid_distinction: The [FEATURES] startinggrid value is parsed into the track object at +0x160, floored to at least 104, and used as the grid-array allocation count. [GRID] GridIndex populates records only for indices below 104. Unauthored indices below the allocation are in-bounds zero-filled records; true memory out-of-bounds access begins only at or above the allocation because the runtime accessor has no visible bound check.
capacity_and_outliers.link_index_guard: The remap pass rejects -1 and indices >= waypoint count. Other negative indices are not visibly rejected and form pointers before the waypoint allocation.
capacity_and_outliers.syntax_limit: No malformed syntax was proven. The numeric parser's strict tuple arity provides the syntax rule, but the public front door exposes only aggregate ranges/samples and not the raw line/file identity needed to label a shipped line malformed.

validation_and_limitations.workspace_validator: pre-existing root errors: missing game-install paths and four source-like files under production
validation_and_limitations.wasted_effort_check: Two avoidable retries: unsupported search context=12 (maximum is 10), and one PowerShell brace typo while filtering front-door output. No broad build/test, polling, or external asset mutation occurred.
